data.name: Uthmaniyah
data.long_meaning: Uthmaniyah is a female name derived from the name Uthman, which means 'young' or 'youth'. It is given in honor of Uthman ibn Affan, the third caliph of Islam.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bearing the name Uthmaniyah connects one to the legacy of Uthman ibn Affan, a revered figure in Islamic history known for his piety, wisdom, and leadership.

in_arabic.name: عثمانية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عثمان، يعني القوة والشجاعة في الإسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: عثمانية اسم يرجع إلى عثمان بن عفان، ثالث الخلفاء الراشدين، مشتق من اسم عثمان الذي يعني القوة والشجاعة، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عظيمة في الإسلام، حيث يرتبط بالخلفاء الراشدين وبالفترة الذهبية في التاريخ الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: عثمانیہ
in_urdu.meaning: عثمان سے مشتق، طاقت اور ہمت کا مطلب
in_urdu.long_meaning: عثمانیہ نام عثمان بن عفان سے ماخوذ ہے، جو خلفائے راشدہ کے تیسرے خلیفہ تھے، اس کا مطلب ہے طاقت، ہمت، اور جرأت، یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر خلفائے راشدہ کے دور میں۔

in_hindi.name: उथमानिया
in_hindi.meaning: उथमान से लिया गया, शक्ति और साहस का अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: उथमानिया नाम उथमान बिन अफ्फान से लिया गया है, जो तीसरे खलीफा थे, इसका अर्थ शक्ति, साहस, और हिम्मत है, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है, खासकर खलीफा के समय में।

in_pashto.name: عثمانيہ
in_pashto.meaning: د عثمان څخه مشتق شوی، د ځواک او زړورتيا معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عثمانيہ نوم د عثمان بن عفان څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې دریم خلیفه و، دا د ځواک، زړورتيا، او جرأت معنی لري، دا نوم په اسلامي دود کې ډیر اهمیت لري، په ځانګړي ډول د خلفاء په دوره کې.

in_english.name: Uthmaniyah
in_english.meaning: Derived from Uthman, meaning strength and courage in Islam
in_english.long_meaning: Uthmaniyah is a name derived from Uthman ibn Affan, the third Caliph in Islamic history. It signifies strength, courage, and determination. The name has deep roots in Islamic tradition, associated with the righteous Caliphs and the golden era of Islamic history. It reflects qualities of resilience and bravery.

data.cultural_impact: Uthmaniyah is a name rich in Islamic history and holds significant cultural importance. Named after Uthman ibn Affan, who was the third caliph of Islam and played a crucial role in the preservation and compilation of the Quran. He is recognized for his unwavering dedication to the religious and political well-being of the Muslim community, and his name carries the weight of this history. This name is a reminder of the importance of preserving Islamic history and upholding the values of dedication, perseverance, and loyalty to the faith and community.
data.spiritual_significance: Uthmaniyah's name carries a deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the name of Uthman ibn Affan, a man who lived his life in service to Allah and the Muslim community. His commitment to preserving the Quran and ensuring its accuracy is an inspiring example of dedicated religious study and devotion. This name signifies a connection to the rich history of Islam, and a reminder to always strive for spiritual growth and service to Allah and the community.
